name: Front Rotors
description: ZL1 / ZL1 1LE front: 390 x 36 mm two-piece rotors (cast-iron friction ring bolted to a separate hat). GM notes the 1LE two-piece fronts cannot be machined. Race: fully floating two-piece discs (AP J-hook, DBA 5000 rings, Girodisc) on aluminum bells with drive bobbins.

components.name: Front brake rotor (friction ring)
components.description: The vented cast-iron disc the pads clamp. On a race car it is a wear item – replace before cracks run from edge to vane or below minimum thickness. Vented, directional vanes: install on the correct side.
components.location: Sandwiched between hub flange and wheel at each front corner (via the hat), centered on the axle, plane z≈±0.70.

factory.name: GM/Brembo 390 x 36 mm two-piece vented front rotor (ZL1, ZL1 1LE)
factory.notes: Two-piece, cannot be turned (TSB). SS: smaller one-piece/two-piece per package; base cars 12.6 in (320 mm) one-piece with FNC coating.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing CP7177 372 x 34 mm 72-vane J-hook disc
raceOptions.notes: Supplied in Essex Gen 6 kits (L/R handed).

raceOptions.name: DBA 5000 Series replacement rings for OEM hats
raceOptions.notes: Use Wildhammer WH38 ring hardware (10.9 serrated bolts) to mount to factory hats.

Wilwood 15.00 in GT / SRP or WCCB carbon-ceramic

specs.Static imbalance limit: GM: > 21 g (3/4 oz) may contribute to vibration

hardware.item: Front brake rotor retention screw (Torx, hat to hub)
hardware.reuse: Reusable (often discarded on race cars – wheel clamps the rotor)
hardware.notes: GM "Front brake rotor bolt" 9 N·m; Gen 5 ZL1 kit used 10 N·m.

installNotes: Clean hub flange and hat mating face to bare metal (rust here = runout/vibration).
Install directional rotors with vanes sweeping rearward at the top (curved vanes pump air outward in forward rotation); check L/R part marking.
Check lateral runout at the rotor edge with lug nuts torqued: aim < 0.05 mm.
Bed new rotors/pads before racing (see brakes.fluid.bedding-procedure).
inspection: Measure thickness at 4 points every event; replace at the manufacturer minimum (stamped on hat/ring) or ~2 mm worn for race discs.
Look for heat-check cracks: small surface crazing OK; any crack reaching the OD edge or into a vane – replace immediately.
Check for uneven pad deposits (vibration) and blueing.

components.name: Front rotor hat (bell)
components.description: Center section that bolts the friction ring to the hub and carries the wheel. Aluminum hats on race discs float on drive bobbins so the ring can expand radially without coning; factory ZL1 hats are bolted rigidly with torque-to-yield bolts.
components.location: Between hub flange and wheel, inboard face against hub.

raceOptions.name: AP Racing 6061 hard-anodized floating hat (Essex kit)

installNotes: Never stack a spacer between hub and hat unless the stud length allows full nut engagement.
inspection: Check hat for cracking around lug holes and for fretting at the hub face.

modelRef.features: Black anodised aluminium hat, scalloped 10-lobe flange

components.name: Rotor ring-to-hat hardware (bolts / floating bobbins)
components.description: Bolts, washers, spring clips or drive bobbins that join ring to hat. Factory ZL1 uses torque-to-yield bolts (replace each time); race floating discs use bobbins with retaining clips/nyloc nuts that must have measurable float.
components.location: Around the inner diameter of each friction ring.

raceOptions.name: Wildhammer WH38 rotor-ring hardware (DBA 5000 rings), 16–24 SS/ZL1
raceOptions.notes: 20 serrated 10.9 zinc-plated bolts for both fronts (10 per rotor); reusable; blue Loctite required.

hardware.torque: Per rotor maker; reference: Gen 5 Z/28 ring-to-hat ≈ 7 ft-lb (100 in-lb, 11 N·m) – verify for ZL1/DBA

installNotes: Thread all bolts by hand, then torque in a star pattern.
Floating discs: confirm 0.1–0.3 mm axial float at each bobbin after assembly (or per maker).
inspection: Check bobbins/bolts for looseness or fretting every event.

components.name: Front brake dust shield (splash shield)
components.description: Stamped steel shield behind the rotor. On a race car it is removed (traps heat) or replaced with a brake-duct backing plate that blows air into the rotor eye.
components.location: Bolted to the front knuckle behind the rotor.

raceOptions.name: Delete / replace with duct backing plate
raceOptions.notes: Essex/GM kit installs may require removing or trimming the stock backing plate.

installNotes: Fit before hub bearing if it is clamped by the hub (check on car).
